Trio HG01683: large chromosomal events from the VCF

Karyotype. child 47,XXY(pat,MI); father 46,XY; mother 46,XX.

child HG01683 (M), father HG01682 (M), mother HG01684 (F). 5510316 sites used of 5587508 records (contig 77192). Genome-wide Mendelian-error rate 0.0105.

Sex chromosomes. child XXY (X 2, Y 0.951 copies: XXY in a reported male (47,XXY)); father XY (X 1.01, Y 0.971 copies: agrees); mother XX (X 2.03, Y 0 copies: agrees). Y depth, father over son (log2, each relative to its autosomes): 0.0273 over 2655 sites.

How to read it

Rows. LRR: log2 of the bin's trimmed-mean depth over the member's autosomal median, with its step fit and the calls (a gain in a cell fraction f reads log2(1 + f/2), a loss log2(1 - f/2); copy-neutral events are drawn at 0). BAF: the alt-allele read fraction at heterozygous sites, with the child's informative sites coloured by the parent of the alt allele. Phased fraction: the maternal-allele fraction along the child, the transmitted-allele fraction along a parent (sites, pooled windows, step fit); thin lines are the auxiliary tracks, which depart from the main track where the child carries two different homologues of one parent. Copies: the LRR step fit's copy number split by the fraction's step fit. Het rate: heterozygous calls per confident call.

Sign convention. Sign convention: in the child, a phased fraction below 1/2 means the paternal homologue is in excess (paternal gain or maternal loss) and above 1/2 the maternal homologue; in a parent, below 1/2 means the event lies on the untransmitted homologue and above 1/2 on the transmitted one.

Calls. source: depth (LRR segmentation), bands (band deviation or heterozygosity rate), phased (a shift of the phased track the depth did not call: a gain or loss in a few per cent of cells, or a uniparental heterodisomy). f: the cell fraction, from the depth for a depth-called gain or loss, otherwise from the bands; f_lrr, f_baf and f_phase are the three estimates side by side. origin: the parent of origin from the informative sites; origin_phase: from the sign of the phased shift; homologues: one or two. A constitutional LOH without Mendelian errors is a run of homozygosity, with them a uniparental isodisomy. Every quantity is in events.tsv, bins.tsv and phased.tsv beside this page; the full guide with pattern cards is guide.html.

Colours.

markmeaning
filled circle #444444LRR per bin: log2 of the bin's trimmed-mean depth over the member's autosomal median (GC- and panel-corrected where applicable)
line #000000step fit of the track (exact total-variation denoising)
filled circle #9C9C9CBAF: alt-allele read fraction at the member's heterozygous sites (subsampled)
filled circle #009E73phased fraction pooled over a window of sites (depth-weighted): 1/2 with equal homologue copy, 1/2 +/- d along an event with the sign giving the parent (child: below 1/2 the paternal homologue is in excess, above 1/2 the maternal; parent: below 1/2 the event lies on the untransmitted homologue, above 1/2 on the transmitted one); hollow where the window deviates in two or more members (paralogy; excluded from fits and scan)
line #D55E00called gain (line at the segment's mean LRR)
line #0072B2called loss
line #CC79A7called copy-neutral event: loss of heterozygosity or uniparental heterodisomy (drawn at LRR 0)
filled circle #D55E00child's depth over the parents' mean depth per site, median per bin (within-family difference)
line #CC79A7child's maternal copy number: the LRR step fit's copy number (2 x 2^LRR) times the maternal fraction's step fit
line #E69F00child's paternal copy number, likewise
bracket #000000event supplied with --events (bracket above the track)

line #56B4E9parent's transmitted-allele fraction at sites where the child is heterozygous and the other parent homozygous; departs from the main track where the child carries two different homologues of this parent
